howToName: How to get your student TIE in Barcelona, Spain
howToDescription: Official path for the tarjeta de identidad de extranjero: empadronamiento, EX-17, cita previa fingerprint appointment, Modelo 790 payment, police appointment, and TIE pickup.

marketingSteps.title: Empadronamiento in Barcelona
marketingSteps.description: Register your address (padrón) at the Ajuntament before your TIE appointment.

marketingSteps.title: EX-17 TIE application form
marketingSteps.description: Complete the EX-17 solicitud de tarjeta de extranjero for your Barcelona TIE.

marketingSteps.title: Cita previa toma de huellas
marketingSteps.description: Book a fingerprint appointment (toma de huellas) on the official Policía Nacional site.

marketingSteps.title: Modelo 790 TIE fee (código 012)
marketingSteps.description: Pay the government TIE issuance fee with Modelo 790 código 012 before your appointment.

marketingSteps.title: Toma de huellas appointment day
marketingSteps.description: Bring EX-17, empadronamiento, Modelo 790 receipt, and passport to your cita previa.

marketingSteps.title: Pick up your TIE card
marketingSteps.description: Collect your tarjeta de identidad de extranjero at the police office with your resguardo.

faqs.question: Do I need an appointment for empadronamiento?
faqs.answer: Often yes — check your local Ayuntamiento.

faqs.question: Can I use a rental contract alone for empadronamiento?
faqs.answer: No — you need the official empadronamiento certificate.

faqs.question: What if I don't have a rental contract?
faqs.answer: Your landlord may need to come with you to the Ayuntamiento.

faqs.question: Can someone book my cita previa on my behalf?
faqs.answer: Yes, but you must attend in person.

faqs.question: What if no cita previa appointments are available?
faqs.answer: Keep checking regularly; slots open at unpredictable times.

faqs.question: Can I pay the Modelo 790 fee later?
faqs.answer: No — bring proof of payment to your fingerprint appointment.

faqs.question: Which banks accept Modelo 790 code 012?
faqs.answer: Most major Spanish banks — you do not need an account.

faqs.question: Do they issue the TIE on the spot?
faqs.answer: No — you collect it later with your resguardo.

faqs.question: Can someone else pick up my TIE?

empadronamiento.title: Register Your Address
empadronamiento.description: Empadronamiento in Barcelona: how to book at the Ajuntament, what documents you need, and how to get a certificado de empadronamiento for your student TIE.
empadronamiento.whyItExists: Empadronamiento registers your address in Barcelona's municipal census. Immigration and many other procedures require proof that you live at a specific address.
empadronamiento.completionPrompt: Did you receive your empadronamiento certificate at the Ayuntamiento?

cta.start: I'm going to register my address

commonQuestions.question: Do I need an appointment?
commonQuestions.answer: Often yes — check the Barcelona online office or call your district office.

commonQuestions.question: What if I don't have a rental contract?
commonQuestions.answer: Your landlord usually must come with their ID and sign an authorization.

commonQuestions.question: How recent must the certificate be?
commonQuestions.answer: For TIE, it should usually be issued within the last 90 days.

proof-of-residence.label: Rental contract or proof of residence
proof-of-residence.description: Signed contract, deed, or landlord authorization.

appointment-confirmation.label: Appointment confirmation
appointment-confirmation.description: Book your visit — VisaMesa can help.
appointment-confirmation.detail: After booking, the Ajuntament de Barcelona (Oficina Virtual) sends a confirmation email with the office address, date, and time. Save or print it before your visit.

attend-ayuntamiento.label: Attend and collect your certificate
attend-ayuntamiento.description: Go in person with all documents above.
attend-ayuntamiento.detail:
On the day of your appointment, arrive a few minutes early, bring all of your original documents, and go to the Ayuntamiento office listed in your appointment confirmation.

Important: You must attend the appointment yourself. VisaMesa can help you obtain the appointment, but we cannot attend the registration on your behalf because the city council must verify your identity in person.

At the appointment, a city council employee will review your documents, verify your identity, and register your address in the municipal register (the padrón). If everything is in order, your registration will be completed.

Once your registration is processed, you will receive your empadronamiento certificate (also called a certificado de empadronamiento). This certificate serves as official proof of your registered address in Barcelona and may be required for future immigration and administrative procedures. If the office cannot issue the certificate immediately, they will explain when and how you can obtain it.

Keep your empadronamiento certificate in a safe place. You will need to bring it with you later during Step 5, when you attend your fingerprint appointment. The certificate is one of the documents required for that appointment.

toma-de-huellas.title: Book Your Fingerprint Appointment
toma-de-huellas.short: Reserve your cita previa for fingerprints and document submission.
toma-de-huellas.description: Cita previa for toma de huellas in Barcelona: book your TIE fingerprint slot on the official Policía Nacional site, what to do when no appointments appear, and how to save your confirmation for appointment day.
toma-de-huellas.whyItExists: Spanish police require a scheduled appointment for TIE applications. Slots in Barcelona are limited and fill quickly, especially in September.
toma-de-huellas.completionPrompt: Do you have your Cita Previa confirmation saved or printed?

commonQuestions.question: Can someone book on my behalf?
commonQuestions.answer: Yes, but you must attend in person.

commonQuestions.question: What if no slots appear?
commonQuestions.answer: Keep checking — new slots open at random times, often early morning.

appointment-confirmation.label: Appointment confirmation
appointment-confirmation.description: Book via VisaMesa or the official site.
appointment-confirmation.detail: After booking, Cita Previa sends an official confirmation email showing the police office, date, and time. Print or save that email — you will need it at the station in Step 5.

required-documents.title: Fill Your EX-17 Form
required-documents.short: VisaMesa pre-fills your TIE application form.
required-documents.description: How to fill the EX-17 form for your Barcelona student TIE: match your passport and empadronamiento, sign the PDF, and bring it to your toma de huellas appointment.
required-documents.whyItExists: The EX-17 is the official TIE application form. Police require a completed, signed copy at your appointment.
required-documents.completionPrompt: Is your EX-17 form reviewed and ready to print?

commonQuestions.question: Do I submit the form now?
commonQuestions.answer: No — print and bring it to your fingerprint appointment in Step 5.

commonQuestions.question: What if my profile details are wrong?
commonQuestions.answer: Update your Profile first, then review the form again.

ex-17-form.label: EX-17 application form
ex-17-form.description: Review the form VisaMesa filled for you.
ex-17-form.detail: Check every field matches your passport and visa. Sign where indicated before your appointment.

pay-fee.title: Pay the TIE Issuance Fee
pay-fee.short: Fill Modelo 790 (VisaMesa does this for you), print it, and pay at a bank.
pay-fee.description: Modelo 790 código 012: pay the TIE issuance fee in Spain before your fingerprint appointment and keep the bank-stamped receipt for the police office.
pay-fee.whyItExists: Paying the official fee is mandatory before your TIE can be processed. The bank-stamped form is proof of payment.
pay-fee.completionPrompt: Did you pay the fee and get your stamped receipt?

cta.start: I'm going to pay the fee

commonQuestions.question: Do I need a bank account?
commonQuestions.answer: No — pay in cash at the counter at most major banks.

commonQuestions.question: Can I pay online?
commonQuestions.answer: Only with Cl@ve or a digital certificate — most students pay at a branch.

modelo-790-form.label: Modelo 790 Code 012 form
modelo-790-form.description: Review the form VisaMesa filled for you.
modelo-790-form.detail: VisaMesa pre-fills the Modelo 790, Code 012 form using the information from your profile, so you can review it before printing and signing.

print-modelo-790.label: Print the form
print-modelo-790.description: Print all copies — barcodes must be clear.
print-modelo-790.detail: Once the form is ready, download and print all copies of the Modelo 790 form. The bank will keep one copy and return the remaining stamped copies to you as proof of payment.

pay-at-bank.label: Pay at a Spanish bank
pay-at-bank.description: Take your printed forms to a Spanish bank.
pay-at-bank.detail:
Take the printed forms to a bank in Spain that accepts government fee payments.

Common banks where people usually pay this fee include:
• CaixaBank
• BBVA
• Banco Santander
• Banco Sabadell
• Bankinter

At the bank, give the printed Modelo 790 forms to the cashier, pay the fee using one of the payment methods accepted by the bank, and the bank will stamp your forms to confirm that the payment has been received.

fee-payment-receipt.label: Stamped payment receipt
fee-payment-receipt.description: Keep the copy the bank stamps for your appointment.
fee-payment-receipt.detail:
After paying, the bank will return your stamped copy of the Modelo 790 form.

Important: Keep this stamped receipt in a safe place. It is your official proof that you paid the government fee.

When you attend your fingerprint appointment in Step 5, you must bring the stamped Modelo 790 receipt with you. Without proof of payment, your appointment may not be completed.

fingerprint-appointment.title: Attend Your Fingerprint Appointment
fingerprint-appointment.short: Print everything, go to the police station, submit your application.
fingerprint-appointment.description: Toma de huellas checklist for Barcelona: EX-17, empadronamiento, Modelo 790 payment, passport photos, and cita previa confirmation for your student TIE appointment.
fingerprint-appointment.whyItExists: Police verify your identity in person, capture biometrics, and accept your application. Missing documents usually means rescheduling.
fingerprint-appointment.completionPrompt: Did you attend your appointment and receive your resguardo?

cta.complete: I attended and got my resguardo

commonQuestions.question: What if I forget a document?
commonQuestions.answer: They may turn you away — rebook and try again.

commonQuestions.question: Do I get the TIE card that day?
commonQuestions.answer: No — you receive a resguardo and collect the card later.

ex-17-form.label: Signed EX-17 form
ex-17-form.detail: You confirmed the EX-17 in VisaMesa in Step 2. Print it, sign where indicated, and bring the signed copy — it is not stored in the app after printing.

modelo-790-receipt.label: Paid Modelo 790 (stamped receipt)
modelo-790-receipt.description: From Step 4 — the bank-stamped copy in your hands.
modelo-790-receipt.detail: This is the physical receipt the bank stamps when you pay in Step 4. VisaMesa cannot view or share it — make sure you have that stamped copy with you.

valid-passport.label: Original passport
valid-passport.description: Must be valid and match your application.
valid-passport.detail: Your original passport — keep it with you, not a copy.

passport-copies.label: Passport photocopies
passport-copies.description: Photo page and visa/entry stamp page.
passport-copies.detail: Make copies at home, at a copy shop (copistería), or at many print kiosks. Bring both the photo page and the visa or entry-stamp page.

student-visa.label: Student visa or long-stay authorization
student-visa.description: The visa or permit allowing stays over 90 days.
student-visa.detail: The visa sticker or authorization in your passport from your home-country consulate.

empadronamiento-certificate.label: Empadronamiento certificate
empadronamiento-certificate.description: Usually issued within the last 90 days.
empadronamiento-certificate.detail: The volante or certificado de empadronamiento you received at the Ayuntamiento in Step 1.

passport-photos.label: Passport-style photos
passport-photos.detail: Get them at a photo booth (foto máquina), copy shop, or photographer if you do not already have compliant photos.

appointment-confirmation-doc.label: Cita Previa confirmation
appointment-confirmation-doc.detail: The confirmation email from Cita Previa after you booked in Step 3 — it shows the police office, date, and time. Print it or show it on your phone.

print-documents.label: Print all documents
print-documents.description: Forms, confirmations, and copies ready to bring.
print-documents.detail: Use a copy shop if you do not have a printer. Organise everything in a folder before you leave.

attend-appointment.label: Attend your appointment
attend-appointment.description: Go to the police office on your booked date and time.
attend-appointment.detail: Arrive early with all documents and your original passport. After fingerprints and review, you receive a resguardo — keep it safe for Step 6.

collect-tie.title: Pick Up Your TIE
collect-tie.short: Return to collect your physical card when ready.
collect-tie.description: Recoger TIE in Barcelona: when your tarjeta de identidad de extranjero is ready, return to the police office with resguardo and passport — often 30–45 days after toma de huellas.
collect-tie.whyItExists: TIE cards are manufactured centrally and delivered to the station. The resguardo proves your application was accepted and authorizes collection.
collect-tie.completionPrompt: Did you collect your physical TIE card?

commonQuestions.question: How do I know when it is ready?
commonQuestions.answer: Check the instructions on your resguardo or contact the office listed.

commonQuestions.question: Can someone else collect it?
commonQuestions.answer: Usually you must go in person with your passport.

resguardo.label: Resguardo from your appointment
resguardo.description: The receipt police gave you in Step 5.

passport-collection.label: Original passport
passport-collection.description: Same passport used for your application.

attend-pickup.label: Collect your TIE card
attend-pickup.description: Go to the office with resguardo and passport.
attend-pickup.detail: Bring both documents. They verify your identity before handing over the card. Check your resguardo for the exact office and whether you need a new appointment.
